Known science foundations of Stellar Engine Simulation Platform.

The Shkadov thruster (statite mirror) is the classic concept; Caplan's stellar engine uses collected mass. Orbital mechanics are simulable. No stellar engine has been built or tested; the platform models hypotheticals.

Key quantity check (Shkadov thrust in N / Sun's weight-equivalent in N): computed ratio 5e-19 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.5. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

Physical and engineering constraints on Stellar Engine Simulation Platform.

Thrust is minuscule vs stellar mass. Stability of megastructures is unproven. Construction is beyond any capability.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 48.6 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is stellar gravity force vs acceleration at 48.6 orders of magnitude (stellar gravity force larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
